title: Age on a date, and today

blocks.text: A birthday is a `LocalDate`: only the date matters. Here "today" comes from a `Clock` passed in rather than from `LocalDate.now()`, so a test can fix the moment and the zone.

items: `static int ageOn(LocalDate birth, LocalDate on)` returns the number of whole years from `birth` to `on`. A year counts only once the birthday has been reached. A `birth` after `on` is refused with an `IllegalArgumentException`.
`static int ageToday(LocalDate birth, Clock clock)` is the age on today's date, where today is the date `clock` shows **in the clock's own zone**.

cases.says: The age is the number of whole years from the birth date to the date, and ageToday uses the given clock.
The day before the birthday, the age is still one year less.
A March 1 birthday in a leap year is reached on March 1 of a common year.
Today is the date the clock shows in its own zone, which can be a day ahead of UTC.
A birth date after the date is refused with an IllegalArgumentException.

concepts: Period.between gives the whole years between two dates, counting a year only once the birthday is reached.
Code that needs today's date takes a Clock, whose own zone decides which date today is.
